system.description: Spend a Willpower Trait to activate for the rest of the scene; everyone within 10 feet grows increasingly hostile and irritable, potentially sparking fights or frenzy, and their agitation lingers (though no longer artificially reinforced) after they leave the radius. Affected individuals may spend a Willpower Trait to calm down for a turn and avoid frenzying, and those with Calm Hearted may resist the effect entirely for a minute with a spent Willpower Trait.
